title: Share {{name}}
description: Who has access to this account and at which level. Only people who manage the account can share it or revoke access.
caption: Shared access to the account
levelOption.USE: Use: copy the username and get the second-factor codes
levelOption.EDIT: Edit: also add credentials and change passwords
levelOption.MANAGE: Manage: also share the account and revoke access
empty.title: This account is not shared yet
empty.description: When you share the account with someone it will appear here.
share.title: Share the account
share.description: Choose the person, the access level and, optionally, when it expires.
share.groupsNote: For now you can only share with a person. Existing group access is shown in the table.
share.expiresAtHelp: Must be a future date and no more than one year away. If left empty, access does not expire.
share.expiryPast: The expiry date must be in the future.
share.granteeRequired: Choose the person to share with.
revoke.title: Revoke the access of {{name}}
revoke.description: {{name}} will lose access to this account. If they already revealed a password of the account, a rotation task will be created to change it.
